minutes.headline: Committee approved a line-item transfer, then debated how to present the five-year staffing plan; no plan decided.
minutes.summary: The committee heard public comment on i-Ready results, approved a budget line-item transfer, a class of 2022 fund release and a donation, and discussed the five-year staffing plan and its use in the town's fiscal forecast. It authorized the chair to sign a letter to the Municipal Building Committee about building-use options and Turkey Hill, accepted the FY23 quarterly budget report, and adjourned.

public_comment.topic: i-Ready results at Turkey Hill compared with March; asked for the plan and urgency, and questioned the equity audit, its cost and the superintendent's approach.
A committee member responded to the public comment and, separately, said the select board's account of the prior school committee discussion on the municipal building committee was mischaracterized.

what_happened.line: The committee approved a budget line-item transfer after the business manager explained the changes, including higher dues and a fire alarm item moved between accounts.
The five-year staffing plan and fiscal forecast were discussed at length with no resolution; the chair said they will be revisited at the next meeting.
The committee voted to authorize the chair to sign a letter on town building use and Turkey Hill, pending a rewrite and individual comments.
The committee accepted the FY23 quarterly budget report, which showed a negative long-term substitute balance and under-budgeted unemployment compensation.
The committee released the class of 2022 remaining funds and accepted a donation to the high school athletic department.

why_it_matters: The staffing plan is where the end of ESSER money meets the town's levy limit. A member said that without a replacement or an override the district would have fewer people in three years, and the plan stays undecided.
The building-use letter and Turkey Hill capital planning could lead to excludable debt or multi-year capital commitments, which would show up on tax bills, but the letter is still being rewritten.
watch_next: The next meeting is to revisit the five-year plan and forecast, with a goals check-in and a possible SEL curriculum presentation.
The chair's rewritten building-use letter, to be circulated for individual comments before it is signed and delivered.
